description: R-EXPR-1 fixture r-expr-1-main2: tables One (one row), Vals (one row of typed scalars: Byte 255, Integer 32767, Long 2147483647, Single 1.5, Double 2.5, Currency 12.3456, Decimal(28,4) from the BSTR "-1844674407370955.1621", Date 45000.5, Yes/No True, Text "7" and "q", Long Null), Big (BIGINT from the BSTR "9223372036854775807", and -1), Den (Id, Denominator, TextValue: (1,2,'12'), (2,0,'abc'), (3,Null,Null)), Dts (DATETIME values -0.25, 0.25, -1.25, -1.5, 0, -0.75, -0.5, 45000.5 with index IX_D), Pat (grouped pattern subjects stored as typed BSTRs, including empty, NUL, surrogate and combining subjects; index IX_S; S AllowZeroLength set True) and Nm (columns named Date, Len and p). Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, ;LANGID=0x0409;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0, dbVersion120); typed values are stored through table-type AddNew/Value/Update; the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE One (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_One PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE Vals (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Vals PRIMARY KEY, B BYTE, I SHORT, L LONG, S SINGLE, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, DT DATETIME, Y YESNO, T TEXT(50), Q TEXT(50), N LONG)
CREATE TABLE Big (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Big PRIMARY KEY, LL BIGINT)
CREATE TABLE Den (Id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Den PRIMARY KEY, Denominator LONG, TextValue TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO Den (Id, Denominator, TextValue) VALUES (1, 2, '12')

CREATE TABLE Dts (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Dts PRIMARY KEY, D DATETIME)
CREATE TABLE Pat (Id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Pat PRIMARY KEY, G TEXT(10), S TEXT(50))
CREATE TABLE Nm (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Nm PRIMARY KEY, [Date] TEXT(20), [Len] LONG, p LONG)
